scripts.generate: dotenv -c -e ../../.env -- prisma generate --no-hints && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),f='./prisma/zod/index.ts',c=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');if(!c.includes(\"import { Prisma }\")){fs.writeFileSync(f,c.replace(\"import * as z from 'zod';\",\"import * as z from 'zod';\\nimport { Prisma } from '../generated/client';\"))}else{fs.writeFileSync(f,c.replace(\"import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';\",\"import { Prisma } from '../generated/client';\"))}"
